claims: The first manned moon landing occurred on July 20, 1969.
The first manned moon landing occurred during NASA's Apollo 11 mission.
Astronauts Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin landed the Lunar Module Eagle at 20:17:40 UTC.
Neil Armstrong took his first step onto the moon's surface at 10:56 p.m. EDT.
The astronauts on NASA's Apollo 11 mission were Neil Armstrong (commander), Buzz Aldrin (lunar module pilot), and Michael Collins (command module pilot).
Neil Armstrong became the first person to walk on the moon.
Buzz Aldrin walked on the moon after Neil Armstrong.
The Apollo 11 landing site was the Sea of Tranquility.
The Apollo 11 crew returned to Earth on July 24, 1969.
The Apollo 11 crew splashed down in the Pacific Ocean.
An estimated 650 million people watched the Apollo 11 landing on television.
